chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the words of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'The nature made by God upon which He has fashioned people' (30:30) — what is that nature?
He said: It is Islam. God fashioned them upon it when He took their covenant on divine unity (tawhid), saying: 'Am I not your Lord?' (7:172), and in it were the believer and the disbeliever.

key_terms.التوحيد: Tawhid: divine unity, the oneness of God; the specific content of the primordial covenant
key_terms.فطرة: Fitrah: the primordial nature or disposition upon which God created all human beings; implies an innate orientation toward tawhid
key_terms.ميثاق: The covenant (mithaq): refers to the primordial covenant in Quran 7:172 where God took a covenant from all souls

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of fitrah in Shia Islam according to Imam Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the Quranic concept of fitrah (primordial nature) in response to a question about Quran 30:30. He explains that the fitrah is Islam itself — God inscribed the acknowledgment of His lordship upon all souls before their earthly existence during the Day of the Covenant (yawm al-mithaq, Quran 7:172). Both believers and disbelievers were present at this covenant, making the recognition of divine unity an innate disposition, though people may later veil it through disbelief.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [30:30] the nature made by Allah in which He has Made the people to be upon, ‘What is that nature?’

Heasws said: ‘It is Al-Islām. Allahazwj Inclined them when Heazwj Took their Covenant upon the Oneness Saying [7:172] Am I not your Lord? And included in it were the Momineen (plural of Momin) and the disbelievers’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“I asked him about the words of Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, ‘The invention of Allah (had a certain) nature with which He created all people. . . .’ [30:30] What is that creation (and nature)?

The Imam said, ‘It is al-Islam. Allah created them with such nature at the time He made a covenant with them to believe in Oneness of Allah as He asked them all, “Am I not your Lord?” when all the believers and the unbelievers were there.’”
